method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the employee, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); dates in one module, the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; two regulative rules (s 11(6) and s 11(7)(b), PARTY ... MUST ... WITHIN ... HENCE FULFILLED LEST BREACH BY ... BECAUSE) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Long Service Leave Act 1981 (NT), Act No. 72 of 1981, reprint REPL021 as in force at 14 October 2015 (last amended by the Statute Law Amendment (Directors' Liability) Act 2015), current on the NT Legislation register on 6 November 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/Long-Service-Leave-Act-1981-NT-current-reprint-REPL021.txt. No regulations under the Act are deposited.

seat: the employee or former employee to whom the Act gives long service leave (ntlsl-employee.l4); the questions a death raises (s 10(3), s 11(7)(b)) are asked from the seat of the deceased employee's personal representative
focus: one of the state and territory long service leave Acts the Fair Work Act leaves in place: the whole operative Act

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run ntlsl-dates.l4 ; l4 run ntlsl-employee.l4 ; l4 run ntlsl-cases.l4
checks.result: 152 assertions written, 152 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file; 3 #TRACEs (1 fulfilled, 2 breached) as their expect lines say (2026-11-07); two deliberately wrong assertions in a scratch file showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text; the Act's own examples in s 11(4), (5) asserted to the dollar.

scope: The whole operative Act. In: s 6(1), (2), (4); s 7(1)-(4), (6); s 8(1)-(8) (s 8(5) as an input, s 8(6)(a) noted); s 9 (in a description); s 10; s 11; s 12; s 13 (as an input); s 14(2) (with s 14(1) in a description); s 16; s 17(1); s 18(1), (2) (in descriptions); s 18A. Out: ss 1, 2, 3, 19 (machinery); ss 4, 5 (savings and transitional for the 1965-1974 Ordinances); s 7(5); s 8(5A); s 14(1), (3) as rules; s 15 (the authorised person); s 17(2); s 18(4). Reasons in NOTES.md.
